text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

1. Reps got about 5 hours back each week. CRM updates stopped being a Friday-night chore.

2. Follow-ups went out the same day, not three days later. Response rates improved.

3. Managers coached from real conversations instead of rep summaries. That changed the quality of feedback.

4. Not everything worked. Noisy sites and side conversations hurt accuracy, and some customers wanted to know before we recorded.

5. Adoption followed trust. Reps used it more once we were clear about what was stored and who could see it.

The tool didn't make anyone sell better. It gave them time and context to do it themselves.

What would you want to know before piloting one?
